about.description: Horizon is Aave Labs’ dedicated RWA market designed for qualified participants and permissioned tokenized collateral. It enables institutions to post permissioned RWAs such as tokenized money market and fixed-income products as collateral and borrow widely used stablecoins, combining DeFi liquidity with issuer-level compliance controls. Retail users can typically participate on the liquidity side by supplying stablecoins to the market.
